name: Vel'Koz
title: the Eye of the Void

Q.name: Plasma Fission
Q.description: Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals 80/120/160/200/240 + 0.9×AP magic damage and Slows by 70% decaying over 1/1.4/1.8/2.2/2.6 second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle. Killing a unit with this restores 20/22.5/25/27.5/30 Mana.
Q.summary: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

W.name: Void Rift
W.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing 30/50/70/90/110 + 0.2×AP magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing 45/75/105/135/165 + 0.25×AP magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges ((varies) second refresh).
W.summary: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

E.name: Tectonic Disruption
E.description: Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for 0.75 seconds and dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.3×AP magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.
E.summary: Vel'Koz causes an area to explode, knocking up enemies, and knocking close enemies slightly away.

R.name: Life Form Disintegration Ray
R.description: Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of ? + 1.25×AP magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by (varies)%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by Organic Deconstruction. Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.
R.summary: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

Passive.name: Organic Deconstruction
Passive.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.
Passive.summary: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Long-range artillery mage who stacks true damage with his ability combo and zones with his R beam. Wins by poke and range, not mobility.
strengths: True damage passive after 3 ability hits
R beam deals huge damage in fights
profile.curveNote: Needs 3 abilities to proc passive true damage.

R.notes: Channel beam; interrupted by crowd control.

profile.windowAgainst: E down: engage freely; he can't peel.
